devdoc.details: Display metadata, entropy state, mint policy, artist authority, revenue      policy, finality manifests, and module lifecycle state live in satellites.

Approval(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when `owner` enables `approved` to manage the `tokenId` token.

ApprovalForAll(address,address,bool).details: Emitted when `owner` enables or disables (`approved`) `operator` to manage all of its assets.

Transfer(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when `tokenId` token is transferred from `from` to `to`.

abortPreparedMintFromManager(uint256,byt.details: The installed caller must differ from the preparing manager. The exact      token/operation match is required; abort removes its identity/data and      rewinds the global token and collection serial allocation frontiers.

completePreparedMintFromManager(uint256,.details: The caller, tokenId, and operationId must match the pending preparation.

params.initialRecipient: Address receiving the completed token and safe-receiver callback.

params.parameterId: Domain-defined identifier for the bounded external call.

returns.failureClass: Protocol failure-behavior classification for this call.
returns.floor: Permanent lower bound in gas units.
returns.value: Current call budget in gas units.

mintFromManager(uint256,address,bytes,by.details: Only the installed manager may call; receiver rejection rolls back the entire mint.

params.collectionId: Existing collection receiving the new token.
params.initialRecipient: Address receiving the ERC-721 token and its safe-receiver callback.
params.mintCommitment: Per-token commitment passed to the entropy registration boundary.
params.tokenData_: Artwork bytes whose exact encoding is committed by tokenDataHash.

returns.collectionSerial: Collection-local serial assigned to this token.

prepareMintFromManager(uint256,bytes,byt.details: Only the installed manager may call; at most one prepared token exists at a time.

params.operationId: Nonzero identity repeated at completion or by a replacement manager during abort.

raiseGasParameter(bytes32,uint256).details: Requires the exact governed transition; callers cannot use this to lower a budget.

params.newValue: Requested call budget in gas units.

royaltyInfo(uint256,uint256).details: Returns how much royalty is owed and to whom, based on a sale price that may be denominated in any unit of exchange. The royalty amount is denominated and should be paid in that same unit of exchange.

abortPreparedMintFromManager(uint256,byt.notice: Aborts a pending preparation through the installed replacement manager.

blockCollectionBurns(uint256).notice: Permanently prevents future burns in a collection through governance.

burn(uint256).notice: Burns a token for its owner or approved operator unless burns or the collection are frozen.

collectionBurnsBlocked(uint256).notice: Returns whether the collection burn block has been set.

collectionBurnsBlockedAtBlock(uint256).notice: Returns the block number of the permanent burn block, or zero if unset.

collectionExists(uint256).notice: Returns whether the collection identifier has been allocated.

collectionFreezeStatus(uint256).notice: Returns whether collection configuration has been permanently frozen.

collectionHasMaxSupply(uint256).notice: Returns whether a finite maximum applies to this collection.

collectionMaxSupply(uint256).notice: Returns the configured lifetime mint cap in tokens.

collectionMintedEver(uint256).notice: Returns the number of completed mints; burns do not reduce this count.

collectionNextSerial(uint256).notice: Returns the next collection-local serial available for allocation.

collectionStatus(uint256).notice: Returns the current collection lifecycle/status code.

collectionSupplyMode(uint256).notice: Returns the collection supply-mode code fixed at creation.

completePreparedMintFromManager(uint256,.notice: Completes the manager operation that owns the prepared token.

coordinatorAtMint(uint256).notice: Returns the entropy coordinator bound at mint completion, or zero before completion.

createCollection(uint8,bool,uint256,uint.notice: Creates a collection through an authorized governance action.

emitBatchMetadataUpdate(uint256,uint256,.notice: Emits metadata invalidation for an inclusive token identifier range.

emitContractURIUpdated().notice: Emits the collection-level ERC-7572 invalidation from an authorized component.

emitMetadataUpdate(uint256,bytes32).notice: Emits a token metadata invalidation from an authorized metadata component.

freezeCollection(uint256).notice: Permanently freezes collection configuration through terminal governance.

freezeSatellitePointer(bytes32).notice: Permanently freezes an installed satellite pointer through terminal governance.

gasParameterInfo(bytes32).notice: Returns the configured call budget and its lower bound in gas units.

getSatellitePointer(bytes32).notice: Returns the stored target, registry commitments, freeze state, and revision.

lastAllocatedCollectionId().notice: Returns the highest collection identifier allocated by Core.

lastAllocatedTokenId().notice: Returns the current token allocation frontier; aborting a preparation can rewind it.

mintFromManager(uint256,address,bytes,by.notice: Allocates and safely mints a token for the installed mint manager.

pendingPreparedMintTokenId().notice: Returns the singleton pending token identifier, or zero when none exists.

prepareMintFromManager(uint256,bytes,byt.notice: Reserves the singleton prepared token without completing its ERC-721 mint.

preparedMint(uint256).notice: Returns the public pending-operation record for a token.

raiseGasParameter(bytes32,uint256).notice: Raises a governed external-call budget without lowering its current value or floor.

setCollectionMaxSupply(uint256,uint256).notice: Applies a governed change to the collection lifetime mint cap.

tokenCollectionIdentity(uint256).notice: Returns the permanent collection mapping, serial, and burn flag for a token.

tokenData(uint256).notice: Returns the token artwork data stored by the mint operation.

tokenLifecycle(uint256).notice: Returns UNKNOWN=0, PREPARED_INCOMPLETE=1, MINTED=2, or BURNED=3.

totalSupply().notice: Returns the live ERC-721 supply, excluding prepared and burned tokens.

totalSupplyOfCollection(uint256).notice: Returns the collection live token count, excluding burned tokens.

updateSatellitePointer(bytes32,address).notice: Replaces an unfrozen satellite after registry and governance-transition checks.

userdoc.notice: Protocol-v1 ERC-721 Core with only the Permanent pre-genesis surface.
